QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Mad Scientist Treglow
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1: Edea told you Treglow's story and asked you to get his guardian key. Defeat #rTreglow#k and get #bTreglow's Key#k.
QuestInfo.2: Edea thanked you, saying that it's not right to let Treglow suffer while he's out of his mind.
